collect.name: Collect
collect.description: Holds values until there are as many as it was told to expect, then sends them as one array. Max's zl group.

counter.name: Counter
counter.description: Counts what arrives and sends the running count. Max's counter.
counter.vue:
<template>
  <v-card :width="width" density="compact">
    <v-card-title class="text-body-2 py-1"><v-icon size="small" class="mr-1">mdi-counter</v-icon>Counter</v-card-title>
    <v-card-text class="py-1 text-h6">{{ count }}</v-card-text>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  props: { node: Object, state: Object },
  data() { return { width: 170 }; },
  computed: { count() { const d = this.node && this.node.data; return (d && d.count) || 0; } },
};
</script>

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Holds a value for a while, then sends it. Max's delay and pipe.
delay.vue:
<template>
  <v-card :width="width" density="compact">
    <v-card-title class="text-body-2 py-1"><v-icon size="small" class="mr-1">mdi-timer-sand</v-icon>Delay</v-card-title>
    <v-card-text class="py-1">
      <v-text-field density="compact" variant="plain" type="number" hide-details label="milliseconds" v-model.number="ms"/>
    </v-card-text>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  props: { node: Object, state: Object },
  data() { return { width: 210 }; },
  computed: { ms: {
      get() { const d = this.node && this.node.data; return d && d.ms !== undefined ? d.ms : 250; },
      set(v) { if (!this.node.data || typeof this.node.data !== "object") { this.node.data = {}; } this.node.data.ms = v; },
    }, },
};
</script>

format.name: Format
format.description: Makes a string out of what arrives, from a pattern with ${...} in it.

gate.name: Gate
gate.description: Lets values through while it is open, and drops them while it is shut. Max's gate.

get.name: Get
get.description: Reads one path out of an object and sends it; a path that is not there goes out missing.

if.name: If
if.description: Tests what arrives against a condition you write, and sends it out then or else.

iterate.name: Iterate
iterate.description: An array in, one element at a time out, then done. Max's iter.
iterate.vue:
<template>
  <v-card :width="width" density="compact">
    <v-card-title class="text-body-2 py-1"><v-icon size="small" class="mr-1">mdi-format-list-numbered</v-icon>Iterate</v-card-title>
    <v-card-text class="py-1 text-caption text-disabled">each element, then how many</v-card-text>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  props: { node: Object, state: Object },
  data() { return { width: 210 }; },
};
</script>

loadbang.name: Loadbang
loadbang.description: Sends once when the graph is drawn, so a graph can start itself. Max's loadbang.
loadbang.set:
/**
 * Loadbang: sends once, when the graph is first drawn.
 *
 * The impulse comes from the presentation, which emits on mount — a user-side
 * event travelling left to right like any other, so nothing here reaches back
 * into the graph.  Where there is no presentation (a run on the server) invoke
 * this node's url to start the same flow.
 */
edges.value = value === undefined ? "BANG" : value;

log.name: Log
log.description: Records what passes through it in the execution's own stream, and passes it on unchanged. Max's print.

pack.name: Pack
pack.description: Cold inputs remember what arrives; bang sends them as one object, keyed by the input each value came in on.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Sends the same value a number of times, counting as it goes, then done. Max's uzi.
repeat.vue:
<template>
  <v-card :width="width" density="compact">
    <v-card-title class="text-body-2 py-1"><v-icon size="small" class="mr-1">mdi-repeat</v-icon>Repeat</v-card-title>
    <v-card-text class="py-1">
      <v-text-field density="compact" variant="plain" type="number" hide-details label="how many times" v-model.number="times"/>
    </v-card-text>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  props: { node: Object, state: Object },
  data() { return { width: 220 }; },
  computed: { times: {
      get() { const d = this.node && this.node.data; return d && d.times !== undefined ? d.times : 4; },
      set(v) { if (!this.node.data || typeof this.node.data !== "object") { this.node.data = {}; } this.node.data.times = v; },
    }, },
};
</script>

route.name: Route
route.description: Sends the value out of the output named by one of its properties (by default 'kind'). Anything unmatched goes out unmatched. Max's route.

select.name: Select
select.description: Compares what arrives with what it was told to match: equal goes out yes, anything else out no. Max's select.

store.name: Store
store.description: Remembers the last value it was given; sends it when banged. Max's v.

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.description: Flips between true and false each time it is banged, and sends which it now is. Max's toggle.
toggle.vue:
<template>
  <v-card :width="width" density="compact">
    <v-card-title class="text-body-2 py-1"><v-icon size="small" class="mr-1">mdi-toggle-switch-outline</v-icon>Toggle</v-card-title>
    <v-card-text class="py-1 text-caption">{{ on ? "on" : "off" }}</v-card-text>
  </v-card>
</template>
<script>
export default {
  props: { node: Object, state: Object },
  data() { return { width: 190 }; },
  computed: { on() { const d = this.node && this.node.data; return !!(d && d.on); } },
};
</script>

trigger.name: Trigger
trigger.description: One in, many out, in a known order: the last output fires first, as Max's trigger fires right to left.

unpack.name: Unpack
unpack.description: Takes an object apart: each key goes out of the output with that name. An array goes out as 0, 1, 2. Last output first, so everything has arrived before the first fires.
